rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Tenacious
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1991).
Introduced in Netherlands by Jan Spek Rozen BV in 2001 as 'Fidji'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2004 as 'Tenacious'.
rows.Bloom: Cherry-red, yellow stripes, lemon-yellow stripes, ages to blush . None to mild fragrance. Medium, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, open bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden.
rows.Notes: Named 'Tenacious' to celebrate the commissioning of the new tall ship purpose built by the Jubilee Sailing Trust
